_about: THE COVERS. One entry per listed ebook and booklet, read by scripts/build-covers.mjs (which draws them) and by the pages (which show them). `id` is the book's folder under client/public/ebook/ and never changes; the files are /covers/<id>-400.webp, -800.webp and .jpg. `title` and `subtitle` are what the cover prints (the two books in client/src/data/book-names.json take theirs from there). `lines` breaks the title by hand, with * before the word or line set in the accent colour; it must spell the title, and may be left out (the title is then broken automatically). `ground` is the field (light or dark), `tone` the engraving's one colour block (blue, olive or clay), `art` the drawing in scripts/lib/cover-art.mjs, `alt` what the picture shows. TO USE A FINISHED COVER IMAGE instead of the drawn one, put the file in content/cover-uploads/ and add "image": "content/cover-uploads/<file>" to the entry: it is cropped to 2 by 3 and written at the same sizes. `kinds` are the lighter cards for the short printables. After any change run `node scripts/build-covers.mjs`.
